        CASE WHEN conservestatus = 'Excellent' THEN 1 WHEN conservestatus = 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN conservestatus = 'Fair' THEN 5 WHEN conservestatus = 'Poor' THEN 7 WHEN conservestatus = 'Critical' THEN 10 END as conserve_status_num
